text:
Divya Rao: Quick sync — we need final paid setup for the May product webinar. Goal: 1.2k registrants, CPL target $10, total budget $12k over 14 days. Planning search + retarget + small prospecting social test.
Sam K: OK. Can we prioritize search intent in week 1, then shift to retarget-heavy in week 2? keeps CPL predictable.
Leah Martinez: Agree. Week 1 search focus: high-intent keywords + sitelinks to the webinar landing page. Week 2: retarget site visitors + engaged viewers (video & blog).
Carlos Chen: For retargeting, audience buckets: 7d engagers, 14d site visitors (non-converters), 30d product page viewers. Use decreasing bid multipliers: 7d = x1.2, 14d = x1.0, 30d = x0.8.
Divya Rao: Perfect — also need creative refresh cadence. Rotation every 4 days, 3 variants (headline-led, CTA-led, benefit-led). Leah will upload new variants by EOD Monday.
Leah Martinez: Upload plan: 3 headlines x 2 images each. I'll name files as `web_may_head1_A.jpg` etc. Do we want a short animated GIF for social test?
Sam K: GIF yes for social test only. Keep GIF CTR as primary metric there. For search ads keep static.
Carlos Chen: Landing page note: add hidden input `utm_source=paid`, `utm_campaign=may_webinar_launch`, `utm_medium=cpc`. Also route inbound leads to webinar sequence via Drift webhook.
Divya Rao: Good catch. Sample UTM snippet for the team:```?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=may_webinar_launch&utm_term={keyword}```
Leah Martinez: I'll attach creative specs in the drive. Also adding fallback copy for low-converting ad: "Reserve your spot — limited seats" test.
Sam K: Budget split suggestion: Search $6k, Retarget $4k, Social prospecting $1.2k, Buffer $0.8k for quick boosts. Manual pacing with daily caps, reassess after 72h.
Carlos Chen: For bidding, target CPA $10 on search; set max CPC cap at $5 initially. Enable automated dayparting between 9am-6pm PST for search.
Divya Rao: Leads routing: ads -> LP -> Drift -> Marketo list `Webinar_May_2026_paid` then webhook to calendar confirmations. Can someone confirm Marketo mapping? @Sam K
Sam K: I’ll confirm Marketo fields: `email, firstName, lastName, utm_source, ad_group, keyword`. Will map to `Webinar_May_2026_paid`.
ads-bot: Creative processing job started for `web_may_head1_A.jpg`, ETA 12m.
Leah Martinez: Campaign naming convention: `paid/webinar/may2026/{channel}/{audience}` — follow this exactly so reporting filters work.
Divya Rao: Reporting: daily slack digest in #marketing-ads, include spend, CPL, conv rate, top keywords, top creatives. Sam please set up the dashboard.
Sam K: Will do. I'll add a threshold alert for CPL > $15 or spend pacing > 120% of expected.
Carlos Chen: Quick check — retarget lookback windows: do we want 14d retention exclusion for prior registrants?
Leah Martinez: Yes exclude `registrants_30d` from paid retargeting. We'll run a separate re-engagement sequence to upsell later.
Divya Rao: Final item — creative approval. @Leah confirm you have stakeholder signoff by Tue 10am so we can launch Wed 9am PST.
Leah Martinez: Will get signoff by Tue 9:30am.
Sam K: One more: add `ad_keyword` param into the Drift payload so sales can see keyword source in the confirmation.
Carlos Chen: Noted. I'll include `ad_keyword` and `campaign` in the webhook.
Divya Rao: Thanks team — moving to action items: Leah upload creatives, Sam set dashboard + Marketo mapping, Carlos implement UTM/webhook + bidding changes. We'll reconvene Fri 10am for first 72h check. :thumbsup:
ads-bot: Campaigns `paid/webinar/may2026/google/search` and `paid/webinar/may2026/google/retarget` queued for launch on 2026-05-06 09:00:00 PST."
